scope: Read-only independent audit of M142 exact-SHA B4 VCS/DC seals, independent B3/B4 protocol attacks, and the M143r2 RTL-interface/cycle boundary.

score.disposition: GO for narrow B4 standalone controller VCS and logic-only DC; independent B3/B4 directed behavior passes; NO-GO for M143r2 RTL-cycle equivalence, physical PPA, energy or speedup.

independent_protocol_hammer.sequence_wrap_method: Backdoor force/release initialized next_sequence_q to the reachable max-1 pre-wrap state; all subsequent fills and selection used normal production handshakes/logic.

findings.title: M143 endpoint recurrence is not cycle-equivalent to registered M142 handshakes
findings.evidence: M143 has 1332 zero-PWP and 300 zero-correction units; M142 rejects same-cycle launch/done, always requires both endpoint transitions, and exhibits a completion-to-next-launch edge for both engines even with another bank waiting.
findings.impact: The 135461009-cycle B4 result and its 2.594690240x/1.812225612x ratios are reproducible model outputs but not M142 RTL throughput.
findings.required_fix: Define edge semantics and recompute every unit with the registered M142 endpoint handoffs, or change RTL with a verified zero/bypass and same-edge turnover contract.

findings.title: Ordering and completion identity are incomplete
findings.evidence: Endpoint identity is bank plus 16-bit tag while the model has 69120 units. Same bank/tag stale completions silently alias, decreasing row IDs/early close are accepted, and the allowed 18-bit sequence counter misorders oldest banks across wrap due to unsigned comparison.
findings.impact: Duplicate, stale, reordered or wrapped lifetimes are not excluded at the standalone interface.
findings.required_fix: Carry an epoch/sequence token through both endpoint request/completion paths, use wrap-safe ordering, and freeze row count/order checks.

findings.title: M143 relies on an absent external SRAM/engine/barrier wrapper
findings.evidence: The model includes 119447791 PWP tokens, 124730596 correction tokens and 160 barriers; M142 has zero macros, no arithmetic, no work length/empty output and no outer barrier/commit interface.
findings.impact: Service duration, storage cost/capacity and barrier behavior are environmental assumptions rather than realized M142 behavior.
findings.required_fix: Implement the bounded descriptor/result SRAM and engine wrapper or publish a cycle-exact driver and replay the frozen workload through it.

findings.title: B2 is model-only
findings.evidence: M143 lists B2/B3/B4, while the non-synthesis M142 parameter contract permits only B3/B4.
findings.required_fix: Label B2 analytical-only or implement and verify it.

findings.title: B3 lacks production seal and matched DC
findings.evidence: Independent B3 directed VCS passes, but the frozen production VCS/DC contracts and receipts are B4.
findings.required_fix: Seal B3 only if it remains a paper candidate and price its external memory.

findings.title: No RTL-to-netlist Formality seal
findings.evidence: DC mapped artifacts and SVF exist, but no M142 Formality completion is admitted.

findings.title: DC timing is prephysical and has only 29.1 ps setup margin
findings.evidence: The 3 ns flow is ideal-clock, ZeroWireload and zero-macro; the critical sequence-selection path has +0.0291 ns setup slack and reported hold +0.0000 ns.
findings.required_fix: Close the sequence selector with real macro/load/clock estimates and PT, then PTPX/routing if cited.

findings.title: M143 result metadata is stale/incomplete after M142 seals
findings.evidence: The frozen M143r2 result still marks m142_vcs_sealed and m142_dc_sealed false, and top-level exact_work omits correction_service_tokens although each bank model contains 124730596.
findings.required_fix: Publish a superseding metadata overlay without changing the frozen result identity.

admitted: exact-SHA B4 controller directed VCS counts and SVA covers
independent B3/B4 directed descriptorization, materialization and ownership behavior
B4 flattened standard-cell logic-only area and ideal-clock ZeroWireload timing at 3 ns
M143r2 same-clock Python module-cycle ratios as reproducible model outputs
not_admitted: M143r2 cycle equivalence to M142 RTL
same-clock model ratios as measured RTL throughput
safe stale completion handling across bank/tag reuse or sequence wrap
implemented descriptor/result SRAM, PWP/correction engines or outer commit controller
macro-inclusive area/timing, routed Fmax, power or energy
